description: Create a process colour swatch (Farbfeld) with the exact name (1–60 characters) from hex (RGB, "#1A2B3C") or cmyk ({c, m, y, k} in percent – for print production); exactly one of the two. on_collision: error (default), update (rewrites the values of the existing colour) or version ("Name 2"). Returns name, swatch_id, collision (none, updated, versioned), existed, space (rgb or cmyk) and values.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name.description: Exact swatch name; must not start with "[".

on_collision.description: What to do when the name exists: error (default) fails, update changes the existing one, version creates "Name 2".

name: create_swatch
title: Create a colour swatch
